scope: source-only jungle terrain and foliage upgrade; no runtime staging, build or launch

license_policy.rule: Record the asset page, author, license URL and SHA-256 of the downloaded diffuse before encoding. Do not use search-result thumbnails.

opaque_seamless_tiles: download the 4K diffuse from the recorded provider URL
crop only if the source itself is not square; reject visible seams
resize to the original dimensions with Lanczos
preserve the original aspect ratio and UV scale
encode a complete DXT1 mip chain
decode level 0 and compare seams, histogram, texel scale and absence of baked directional light
baked_uv_composites: do not replace with a generic material
upscale the RGB in place without crop, rotation, warp or repacking
retain painted path, clearing and transition coordinates
encode at the original dimensions and format
alpha_atlases: upscale or regenerate RGB only in the existing atlas registration
restore level-0 alpha byte-for-byte from the decoded original
retain original RGB where generated alpha confidence is below 240
preserve alpha-test coverage for the renderer's D3DCMP_GREATER 0xa0 contract, with no more than 0.2 percentage points or one texel of discrete mip error
reject any crop, repack, new silhouette, transparent-edge halo or UV-boundary drift

assets.role: repeatable close-range grass and jungle floor diffuse
assets.risk: The original grass has very small, noisy blades. Match its world-space frequency before acceptance or the 512px tile will visibly repeat.

assets.original: 512x512 DXT1, opaque; one model consumer each
assets.method: registered upscale or controlled RGB repaint
assets.reason: These are authored transitions with fixed stone boundaries, so a generic CC0 square would destroy the mesh transition contract.
assets.risk: U1 and U2 must remain a matched pair; independent replacement will create discontinuities.

assets.reason: The images contain authored roads and clearing masks at fixed UV coordinates; they are not seamless ground swatches.
assets.risk: Image generation or CC0 replacement can move the paths off the collision/geometry layout.

assets.method: existing registered generated replacement is structurally compatible; inspect runtime before accepting
assets.risk: This is aerial canopy, not walkable ground. Replacing it with dirt or grass would be a semantic regression.

assets.method: detail-preserving upscale/repaint after a representative in-scene identification
assets.risk: Its gray grading may be intentional for lighting or distance; a saturated CC0 forest texture can break scene depth.

assets.original: treePalms 2048x1024 A8R8G8B8 with 256 alpha values; trees 2048x2048 A8R8G8B8 with binary alpha
assets.method: existing RGB regeneration under original byte-exact level-0 alpha
assets.risk: Generic foliage atlases are UV-incompatible. Keep current silhouettes and atlas regions exactly registered.

assets.role: remaining palm frond and sprite alpha atlases
assets.original: leafPalms 2048x512 A8R8G8B8 binary alpha; PalmsAlphaLitle01 512x128 DXT5 graded alpha; PalmsSprites 512x512 DXT5 graded alpha
assets.method: registered RGB upscale/repaint with original level-0 alpha restored byte-exact
assets.risk: DXT5 atlases contain soft alpha. Threshold-only masks would destroy feathered edges; preserve the full 0-255 channel and premultiplied-filter the mip chain.

acceptance: all outputs keep original dimensions, aspect and codec family
alpha-atlas level-0 alpha bytes exactly equal the decoded originals
alpha mip coverage for D3DCMP_GREATER 0xa0 remains within 0.2 percentage points or one texel while dimensions are at least 8x8
seamless tiles pass edge-difference and 3x3 contact-sheet inspection
baked composites preserve landmark and transition registration
no prepared file is staged until a representative real scene proves scale, color and repetition
